## Target context

- Env: dev
- Project: (none)
- Command: 2 (see structured target_context.commands_run)

[F005] Both findings are addressed and the targeted suite is green. Summary:

**[high, test_coverage]** — The F005 test file was untracked. I ran `git add scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_f005_workflow_help_snippets.py` and confirmed it now reports `A` in `git status --short` and resolves under `git ls-files`, so it ships in the deliverable and is discoverable in a fresh clone.

**[medium, correctness]** — Lifecycle-mutation help previously said only "mutate only when DontPanic asks for it," omitting the explicit user-approval half of AC2. I rewrote the `LIFECYCLE_MUTATION` predecessor hint in `command_guidance.py` to "Inspect what-now/next first; do not auto-run unless DontPanic surfaced an automatable action or the user explicitly approved it." — now parallel to the dispatch/paid wording and carrying both halves of AC2's condition. Because the help footer is projected verbatim from this inventory field (not an ad-hoc string), the `plan lock --help` output now teaches the approval gate. I updated `test_lifecycle_help_warns_against_auto_mutating` to assert the new "do not auto-run unless dontpanic surfaced" and "the user explicitly approved it" wording.

Commands run:

$ pytest scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_f005_workflow_help_snippets.py -q  (15 passed)
$ git add scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_f005_workflow_help_snippets.py

Command behavior is unchanged — the snippet remains a help-only footer sourced from the shared F002 inventory helper.
